answer: Forging N identities costs N times the bond plus N times the energy, so the attacker's marginal cost rises linearly while legitimate agents amortize one stake. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work tied to physical resource claims: each agent must burn compute to solve a unique challenge seeded with a karst terrain hash, and stake a bond recorded at the wharf registry on the island node. Peers verify the karst seed and wharf ledger before attesting, making cheap mass identity creation unprofitable. From Agent0203's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
